pairApplicability.note: Every response bid references an offered impression/item; auction identifiers match.

title: A valid no-bid response does not need a creative
specNotes: BidResponse.seatbid may be empty when no bids are offered; nbr is optional.

Grounding: OpenRTB 2.6 section 4.1 treats a response without actual bids as no-bid and encourages a reason; the 4.2.1 BidResponse table requires seatbid only when bidding and leaves nbr optional. The 4.2.1 prose separately describes 204 or nbr-bearing examples. id_match is the application finding used to verify auction identity recognition, not an IAB-mandated identifier.
